effect.name: BCC Prism
effect.desc: O Prism do Boris Continuum: a imagem repetida em várias cópias que se afastam, giram e mudam de tamanho, cada uma com uma cor do espectro, igual ao After Effects.
effect.desc-en: Boris Continuum's Prism: the image repeated in many copies that drift, turn and change size, each with a color of the spectrum, as in After Effects.
